aiReviews.claim: Current Date must be numeric and must not exceed 6 bytes.
aiReviews.sourceDetail: Element 21 is numeric, fixed six digits in MMDDYY form, originates at BUYPASS, and lists component ranges for month, day, and two-digit year.

aiReviews.claim: Current Time must be numeric and must not exceed 4 bytes.
aiReviews.sourceDetail: Element 22 is numeric, fixed four digits in HHMM form, originates at BUYPASS, and includes time-zone and daylight-saving adjustment.

aiReviews.claim: Cut Time must be numeric and must not exceed 4 bytes.
aiReviews.sourceDetail: Element 23 is numeric, fixed four digits in HHMM form, identifies the merchant's end-of-day settlement time, and has a separate automatic-settlement timing rule.

sourceEvidence.quote: Representation: Fixed length of six digits (MMDDYY)
Valid Codes/Values: Code Description 01–12 Month of the year 01–31 Day of the month 00–99 Last two digits of the year
Representation: Fixed length of four digits (HHMM)
Includes adjustments for the time zone and daylight saving time.
Valid Codes/Values: Code Description 01–24 Hour of the day 01–60 Minute of the hour
Character Type: N Maximum Length: 4 bytes
Purpose: Identifies the merchant’s end-of-day settlement time.

Processing Rules: For devices that use an automatic cut time, the device should start the settlement procedure 30 minutes prior to the merchant’s cut time if the settlement has not been completed by the clerk for that business day.
Valid Codes/Values: Code Description 01–24 Hour of the day 01–60 Minute of the hour
